title: From Perpetrators' Digital Footprints to Behavioral Communities: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Bengali Cyberbullying Analysis--- FULL VERSION
abstract: arXiv:2610.30885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyberbullying involves behavioral and contextual patterns beyond isolated abusive messages. However, existing approaches remain fragmented across content detection, semantic representation, and network analysis, with limited interpretable perpetrator representations, multi-scale structural modeling, and explanations of behavior-driven similarity and influence propagation. These limitations hinder the identification of persistent perpetrators, characterization of behavioral communities, and assessment of potentially influential users. translated_title: 从施暴者数字足迹到行为社区：一个面向孟加拉语网络欺凌分析的本体驱动框架（完整版）
translated_abstract: 网络欺凌涉及超越孤立辱骂信息的行为和情境模式。然而，现有方法在内容检测、语义表示和网络分析等方面仍然碎片化，缺乏可解释的施暴者表示、多尺度结构建模，以及对行为驱动相似性和影响力传播的解释。这些局限阻碍了对持续性施暴者的识别、行为社区的刻画以及潜在有影响力用户的评估。本文提出了本体驱动的网络欺凌行为与网络分析框架（ODCBNA），这是一个以施暴者为中心的框架，整合了需求驱动的本体设计、知识图谱构建、行为建模、社区分析和影响力建模。以孟加拉语情境化多样化网络欺凌语料库（BenCoDiC）作为应用案例，ODCBNA识别出1,063名至少拥有三条欺凌相关内容的用户（摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: 本文提出以施暴者为中心的本体驱动框架ODCBNA，通过知识图谱构建、行为建模、社区分析和影响力建模，在孟加拉语网络欺凌分析中实现持续性施暴者识别、行为社区刻画和有影响力用户评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ODCBNA, a perpetrator-centric ontology-driven framework integrating knowledge graph construction, behavioral modeling, community analysis, and influence modeling to identify persistent perpetrators, characterize behavioral communities, and assess influential users in Bengali cyberbullying analysis.
